diagnosis.cause: Family root discovery compared the selected checkout key case-sensitively. Environment workspace selection also tried the canonical repository ID as a literal directory name instead of using the uniquely discovered checkout path.

earlier_scheduler_result_preserved.interpretation: The latest Family summary is a separate snapshot observation. It does not rewrite or claim to resolve the earlier exact scheduler result.

workspace_authority.selected_commons_remote_relation: local main is one commit behind origin/main

service_cost.interpretation: Measured service duration; not classified as unnecessary work. Further investigation is warranted before attributing avoidable burden.

outcome.interpretation_limit: The selected Commons vocabulary is now loadable by the Family pass and its bounded summary is visible in ECI. The prior scheduler result remains unavailable, and no exact execution identity links the later domain summary to that result. The evidence verifies integration behavior, not agent benefit or longitudinal effectiveness.

request.operation: Make selected Family service availability and its latest bounded result discoverable in ECI.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Canonical selected Commons checkout is not recognized by the Family service
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment workspace resolution, Family ambient service, and capability intelligence
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A recorded Family owner-pass result reported vocabulary-unavailable while the current session selected a clean Commons checkout under the canonical lowercase repository identity.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Resolve selected repositories through canonical identities and their discovered paths, and preserve bounded service-availability evidence in ECI.

improvement_relation.basis: Environment now selects the uniquely discovered checkout path case-insensitively; Family resolves the selected Commons key case-insensitively; owner-pass results retain a strict allowlisted availability reason; and ECI exposes the latest bounded Family summary as separate snapshot evidence whose digest participates in projection identity.
improvement_relation.effectiveness_assessment: Selected checkout resolution, live Family vocabulary loading, and projection visibility are verified. Agent burden reduction and longitudinal effectiveness are not established.
